dublinCore.dc:title: 119 HR 10696 IH: Ad-Free Means Ad-Free Act
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Riley of New York introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce

form.official-title: To prohibit providers of streaming services from advertising ad-free services and later adding ads, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Ad-Free Means Ad-Free Act.

subsection.text: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Federal Trade Commission shall promulgate regulations under section 553 of title 5, United States Code, that—

paragraph.text: prohibit a provider of a video streaming service from offering or advertising services as not including advertisements and, within one year of the initial subscription date or the total length of the contract (whichever is longer), adding advertisements to the service for any subscriber who enrolled in an option that purported to not include advertisements; and

if such a subscriber cancels and re-enrolls in such a subscription, prohibit such a provider from adding advertisements to the relevant service within one year of the re-enrollment date or the total length of the contract (whichever is longer).

subsection.text: Nothing in this section may be construed as excluding a provider of video streaming services from the prohibition described under subsection (a) because the services are offered to a consumer through a third party.

paragraph.header: Unfair or deceptive acts or practices
paragraph.text: A violation of subsection (a) or a regulation promulgated under such subsection shall be treated as a violation of a regulation under section 18(a)(1)(B) of the Federal Trade Commission Act (15 U.S.C. 57a(a)(1)(B)) regarding unfair or deceptive acts or practices.

The Federal Trade Commission shall enforce subsection (a) and any regulation promulgated under such subsection in the same manner, by the same means, and with the same jurisdiction, powers, and duties as though all applicable terms and provisions of the Federal Trade Commission Act (15 U.S.C. 41 et seq.) were incorporated into and made a part of this Act. Any person who violates such subsection or a regulation promulgated under such subsection shall be subject to the penalties and entitled to the privileges and immunities provided in the Federal Trade Commission Act.

subsection.text: In this section, the term video streaming service means an entity that makes available through a paid subscription directly to the end user through a distribution method that uses internet protocol to show media directly to viewers that is—

paragraph.text: video content the entity makes available for users to view.
